description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2016 World Championships, built around Yanmega BREAK, new in XY—Steam Siege. Forest of Giant Plants, Yanmega's Sonic Vision Ability and Judge let it make big attacks at once, and once enough Pokémon are in the discard pile, Vespiquen's Bee Revenge closes out the game. The 2016 World Championships were held at the San Francisco Marriott Marquis in San Francisco, California, from 19 to 21 August 2016.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2016 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
